query:
SELECT
            t.database_id AS "database_id!",
            t.version AS "version!",
            (de.database_id IS NOT NULL AND de.trashed_at IS NULL) AS "searchable!",
            now() AS "read_at!"
        FROM database_tables t
        LEFT JOIN database_entities de ON de.database_id = t.database_id
        WHERE t.id = $1
